title: Office of Naval Intelligence man offers Dark Skies creators a deal, which they refuse

tellings.quote: feel good about him. I mean, the guy that we we thought that the guy that came and was so abusive to us in the in the conference room would be our boss.

plain: Brent Friedman, a Hollywood writer who helped create Dark Skies, a 1990s TV series about a hidden alien presence, told the podcast host Jesse Michels that in the mid-1990s in Los Angeles a man from the Office of Naval Intelligence, the US Navy's spy service, offered him and his co-creator Bryce Zabel a deal. Friedman says the man was abusive to them in a conference room, and they feared he would end up as their boss, so they turned the deal down. If true, it would show military intelligence trying to shape a UFO story on television.
